geeklist.title: AUCTION CLOSED - THE SPECTACULAR AUCTION THAT WILL SHIP AFTER BGGCON with BGGCON PICKUP!!! - Ends 12NOV2025 7:00 PM CST
geeklist.description:
[b][size=18]Hi! Welcome to my auction. Rules are below.[/size][/b]
[b][u]AUCTIONS WILL NOT SHIP UNTIL AFTER BGGCON.[/u][/b]
Please read anti sniping rule #4.
After the auction ends, I will close out the auction and mark all of the winning bids. But I will not have time to ship anything before BGGCON which runs Nov 19-23. I will send invoices during the week of Nov 24th. Rule #12 now refers to after BGGCON.
:d10-1: End date is in the Geeklist title.
:d10-2: Bids below the starting bid will be considered at the end of the auction.
:d10-3: All bids must be in $1 increments. Please list your zip code when bidding.
:d10-4: [u]Each item must go at least 2 hours without a bid. Otherwise, that particular item will be extended until such a time occurs.[/u]
:d10-5: Buyer will pay actual shipping costs from zip code 76060. I use pirateship to get quotes. [b]Shipping requires a $5 minimum purchase.[/b]
:d10-6: Pick up is available at BGG Fall during the VFM Meetup. If purchase is a high dollar amount for BGG pick up, I may require partial or full payment at the conclusion of this auction to avoid a no-show at the con. Please message me if you have questions about picking up at the convention.
:d10-7: Once all auctions are finished I will list a bulk item in the marketplace so BGG will get their 3% commission. [thread=488661]This meets the requirements posted here.[/thread]
:d10-8: All games are complete unless otherwise listed. I will only list any major cosmetic issues. Some boxes have wear. Some expansion boxes and inserts may not be included, depending on how I stored the game.
:d10-9: Please ask any additional questions about the games before bidding. Pictures are available upon request.
:d10-1::d10-0: I will ship internationally, but it is usually expensive.
:d10-1::d10-1: PayPal is preferred. I can also accept Zelle, Venmo, or Cash App.
:d10-1::d10-2: After the auction, it typically takes 3-4 days for me to get invoices out then 3-4 days to get everything shipped. I will post updates in this header after the auction ends. Kindly wait one week after sending payment before asking for tracking information since this only slows down the process of me shipping games and doesn't get the games delivered any faster.
:d10-1::d10-3: 13 was added on 03NOV2025 @ 21:21 CST. Games without bids may be sold to BGGcon attendees. So if you are interested in a game, get a bid on it ;)
[b][size=24][color=#e0102f]Update 13NOV2025[/color][/size][/b] Auction is closed! Thanks to everyone that bid! I will message those picking up games at BGG with details. [b][u]If you are picking up games at BGG and you didn't state that with your bid, please geekmail and let me know.[/u][/b] All other winners will receive an invoice a few days after BGG. Please send me your zip code if you didn't list it with your bid.
